blocks.text: Hypothesis test karna ek wazeh process par chalta hai (Figure 7.1 dekhein). Process hypotheses tay karne se shuru hota hai. Phir data dhyan se jama kiya jata hai, test statistics nikale jate hain, nataij ko muqarrar miyar (criteria) se milaya jata hai, aur aakhir mein faisla hota hai. Sahi qadam ghaltiyan kam karte hain aur test ko munsifana (fair) rakhte hain. Hypothesis testing qabil-e-bharosa nateejon tak le jati hai.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Testing wazeh qadmon par chalti hai. Data jama aur analyze hota hai. Nataij ko miyar se milaya jata hai. Nateeje dhyan se nikale jate hain. Durust tests qabil-e-bharosa nataij dete hain.

blocks.alt: Chaar dabbe oopar se neeche, teeron se jure: 1. State the Hypothesis, 2. Set Significance Level, 3. Collect Data, 4. Perform a Test. Aakhri dabbe se do mure hue teer nikalte hain: baen taraf 'If p-value > α' se sabz dabba 'Accept Hypothesis'; daen taraf 'If p-value < α' se surkh dabba 'Reject Hypothesis'.
blocks.caption: Figure 7.1: Hypothesis testing ka process (kitab ki Figure 7.1 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Chaar qadam oopar se neeche chalte hain; aakhir mein p-value ka α se muqabla (comparison) faisla karta hai ke kaunsa nateeja hoga.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 7.1 mein p-value > α par 'Accept Hypothesis' likha hai. Statistics mein behtar alfaaz 'H₀ reject nahi hota' hain, kyunke test sirf yeh batata hai ke H₀ ke khilaf saboot kafi nahi mila; yeh H₀ ko sach sabit nahi karta. p-value < α ho to H₀ reject hota hai.
Hypothesis testing ke qadam

Pehle null aur alternative hypotheses tay kiye jate hain. Phir significance level chuna jata hai. Samples se data jama hota hai. Test statistics nikale jate hain aur p-value maloom ki jati hai. Nataij ko significance level se milaya jata hai, aur accept ya reject ka faisla kiya jata hai.
Hypothesis testing ki saadi misalein

Saadi misalein testing samajhne mein madad deti hain. Ek misaal exam ke nataij test karna hai; doosri average qad (height) check karna. Samples se data jama hota hai, bunyadi tests se analyze hota hai aur nateeje wazeh tor par nikale jate hain. Saadi misalein aitmad barhati aur concept aasani se samjhati hain.
Advanced tests: F-test aur chi-square test

Advanced tests pecheeda data sambhalte hain. F-test variances (phailao) ka muqabla karta hai aur analysis of variance (ANOVA) mein use hota hai. Chi-square test rishte (relationships) check karta hai aur categorical data (qismon mein bata hua data) ke saath use hota hai. Yeh tests gehra analysis karte hain, sakht qawaid par chalte hain, aur inhein samajhne se maharat aur ilm barhta hai.

Numerical example: hypothesis testing
Ek school dekhna chahta hai ke kya parhane ke naye tareeqe ne talaba ke marks behtar kiye hain. Pehle average marks 70 the.
Naye tareeqe se parhe 10 talaba ke sample ne yeh marks liye:
Qadam 1: Hypotheses likhein
Null hypothesis (H₀): Naya tareeqa marks behtar nahi karta (μ = 70).
Alternative hypothesis (H₁): Naya tareeqa marks behtar karta hai (μ > 70).
Qadam 2: Significance level tay karein
Qadam 3: Sample mean nikalein (tamam marks jama kar ke 10 par taqseem)

blocks.text_alt: x̄ = tamam qeematon ka jama / n = 770/10 = 77

blocks.text: Qadam 4: Standard deviation nikalein (har mark ka 77 se farq le kar us ka murabba (square) karein; in murabbon ka jama 70 hai)
Qadam 5: t-value nikalein
Qadam 6: Faisle ka qaida (decision rule)
t-distribution table ya statistical software se t = 7.93 aur df = 9 ke liye one-tailed p-value taqreeban 0.000012 (1.2 × 10⁻⁵) aati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab p = 0.00002 chhapti hai. Yeh two-tailed (dono taraf wali) p-value hai. Lekin H₁ kehta hai μ > 70, yani test one-tailed (sirf ek taraf ka) hai, is liye sahi p-value taqreeban 0.000012 hai. Dono suraton mein p 0.05 se bohat chhoti hai, is liye faisla (H₀ reject) nahi badalta.
df = 9 par p-value bohat chhoti hai (p < 0.05).
Qadam 7: Nateeja
Kyunke p-value < α, hum null hypothesis reject karte hain.
Aakhri nateeja: Parhane ka naya tareeqa talaba ke marks numayan tor par behtar karta hai.

blocks.alt: Das number 68 se 82 tak ki number line ke oopar nuqton ki shakal mein, 78 par do nuqte. Dashed surkh line purana mean 70 (H0) aur sabz line namoone ka mean 77. Dabba hal: n = 10, jama 770, mean 77, s = sqrt(70 / 9) = 2.79; t = 7 / 0.88 = 7.93, df = 9; p < 0.05, is liye H0 radd aur naye tareeqe ne number barhaye.
blocks.caption: Parhane ke tareeqe wali misaal (kitab ki misaal par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Dason number 70 se oopar aur aik doosre ke qareeb hain, isi liye t itna bara hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar misal mein namoone ka mean wahi standard deviation ke saath 71 hota to t kya hota, aur kya H0 phir bhi radd hota (df = 9 par alpha = 0.05 ki one-tailed critical value 1.83 hai)?
blocks.explanation: t = (71 - 70) / 0.88 = 1.13. Kyunke 1.13 < 1.83, t critical region mein nahi aur H0 radd nahi hota: aik number ka izafa ittifaq ho sakta hai.
